Conventional AoI tracks the age of the latest received update, but it does not describe the freshness of the latent representations used by the perception task. We introduce **Age-of-Latent (AoL)** and jointly adapt the temporal window of integration, camera updates, encoding, and transmit power. Results show a better AoL-resource trade-off than the benchmarks while maintaining prediction reliability, particularly during prolonged and severe camera outages.
